select url.*, su1.avatar as userAvatar,su1.realname as userName,su1.phone as userPhone, su2.avatar as referrerAvatar,su2.realname as referrerName,su2.phone as referrerPhone from ums_referrer_log url left join sys_user su1 on su1.id=url.member_id left join sys_user su2 on su2.id =url.referrer_id where 1 = 1
and url.referrer_id = #{paramCondition.referrerId}
and ( su1.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{paramCondition.keyword},'%') or su1.phone like CONCAT('%',#{paramCondition.keyword},'%') or su2.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{paramCondition.keyword},'%') or su2.phone like CONCAT('%',#{paramCondition.keyword},'%') )
order by url.create_time desc
